name: Katei Kuiji
source:
The head of security at Ashiya Tower. He understands the mechanism that trapped everyone inside. Despite his confidence, his words don't always seem to align with reality.

[spoiler]His real name is Kyuuka Ashiya. He is a descendant of the Ashiya family, who was cut out of the family and changed his identity due to involvement in the murder.[/spoiler]
